notes: Small synthetic corpus: 16 Flask apps with one planted flaw each. These numbers say how ProofGate does on THIS corpus, not on real apps.
The corpus and ProofGate's rules were written by the same team. Rules were not tuned after seeing results; any later tuning must be disclosed in bench/README.md.
Layers 6, 7 and 9 are not built yet, so 'bundle' and 'config' recall mostly reflect layer 1-5 only.
The 'union' column combines the baseline tools that were available on this machine, listed in tables.union.of.
